verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a tax-calculation engine, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes AvaTax as a hosted service reached through REST APIs, SDKs, MCP servers and a free trial account, with nothing on an on-premises or self-hosted deployment of the core product. SDKs and API access are client-side building blocks, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
